panels.title: General Counters, CPU, Memory and File Descriptor Stats

panels.description: Average user and system CPU time spent in seconds.
panels.title: Average CPU Usage

panels.description: Virtual and resident memory size in bytes.
panels.title: Average Memory Usage

targets.expr: pg_stat_activity_count{job="$job", datname=~"$datname", instance=~"$instance", state=~"idle|idle in transaction|idle in transaction (aborted)"}

panels.title: Idle sessions
panels.description: Number of idle or idle-in-transaction PostgreSQL sessions.

targets.expr:
rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="$job", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[$interval])
/
(
  rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{job="$job", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[$interval])
  + rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="$job", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[$interval])
)

panels.description: Rate of data written to temporary files by queries in this database.
panels.title: Temp File Write Rate

targets.legendFormat: write_time - Total amount of time that has been spent in the portion of checkpoint processing where files are written to disk.
sync_time - Total amount of time that has been spent in the portion of checkpoint processing where files are synchronized to disk.

list.label: datasource
list.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
list.description: The Prometheus data source containing PostgreSQL exporter metrics.

list.label: Interval
list.name: interval
list.description: The lookback window used by rate and irate queries. Auto follows the dashboard time range and resolution.

list.label: Job
list.name: job
list.description: The Prometheus scrape job. In this Compose stack, postgresql is the job that scrapes postgresql-exporter.

list.label: Instance
list.name: instance
list.description: The exporter endpoint selected by the Job. The default is the Docker Compose service at postgresql-exporter:9187.

list.label: Database
list.name: datname
list.description: PostgreSQL database name. All selects every database exposed by the exporter.

list.label: Lock table
list.name: mode
list.description: PostgreSQL lock mode used to filter the lock panels.
